text: (1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health, have a strong academic background, consciously abide by Chinese laws and school regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people. (2) Foreign citizens who have completed high school education or have equivalent qualifications and hold valid passports, aged between 18 and 25. Those under 18 years old must submit a guardianship guarantee letter. For those who were Chinese citizens originally and later acquired foreign nationality, the relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education shall be followed.
